clue.text: Publicly displayed the slapdash work — it's outrageous!

parts.note: something overt is openly shown rather than hidden

indicators.note: slapdash means carelessly thrown together, so the little word beside it is jumbled

parts.note: OP is short for opus, a musical work

explanation.surface: A critic sneers at a sloppy piece of work put on public show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Publicly displayed' reads as a verb phrase but gives the adjective overt; 'slapdash' jumbles the little word to HET.
explanation.definitionFit: Something excessive and beyond reasonable bounds is outrageous.

clue.text: From France, you reported the same old magic

indicators.note: reported means spoken, so we use how the French word sounds rather than its spelling

parts.note: the French word for you is vous
DO is short for ditto, meaning the same again

explanation.surface: A French speaker describes the same ancient sorcery.
explanation.walkthrough: French VOUS is said 'voo', with the S silent.
explanation.definitionFit: Voodoo is a Caribbean folk religion associated with spells and sorcery.

clue.text: Gripes abominably, greeting Italian composer

indicators.note: doing something abominably means doing it terribly, so the letters are mangled

parts.note: hi is an informal greeting

explanation.surface: Someone grumbles dreadfully while saying hello to a musician from Italy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'abominably' looks like a comment on the griping, but it signals the shuffle that yields RESPIG.
explanation.definitionFit: Ottorino Respighi wrote the Pines of Rome and was an Italian composer.

clue.text: Maybe lead guitars and drums played loud

definitions.meaning: lead is one example of a dense, weighty metallic element
a genre of rock music with distorted guitars, pounding drums and great volume

explanation.definitionFit: Lead is a dense metal, and the phrase also names a loud rock genre.

clue.text: Leaves for the cup at this stage of the afternoon

definitions.text: Leaves for the cup at this stage of the afternoon

parts.words: Leaves for the cup at this stage of the afternoon
parts.note: the hour when the leaves that brew a cuppa are put in the pot, in the late afternoon

explanation.definitionFit: The British late-afternoon pause for a drink of brewed leaves and a snack.

clue.text: Familiar piano or organ sensitive to touch

parts.note: a familiar is a close friend, a pal
P is the musical abbreviation for piano, meaning softly

explanation.surface: Asks whether a well-known piano or church organ responds to touch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Familiar' looks like an adjective but is a noun for a friend.
explanation.definitionFit: A palp is a sensory feeler on an insect or crustacean, used for touching.

clue.text: Right person to contemplate what's in store?

definitions.text: Right person to contemplate what's in store?

parts.words: Right person to contemplate what's in store?
parts.note: the shopper browsing goods in a shop, who by the saying is always right

explanation.definitionFit: A shopper who buys goods; 'the customer is always right' is a retail saying.

clue.text: Immediately cut means to provide legal access

indicators.note: cut tells us to trim the final letter from the phrase for immediately

parts.note: right off means at once, straight away
a way is a means or method

explanation.surface: A lawyer explains how at once to provide public entry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cut' drops the last F from RIGHT OFF.
explanation.definitionFit: A legal entitlement to pass across someone else's land is a public path entitlement.

clue.text: To make a cancellation, one rings

parts.note: to annul is to cancel or declare void
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone telephones to cancel a booking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rings' looks like a verb about phoning, but is a plural noun.
explanation.definitionFit: Annuli are ring-shaped figures, the plural of annulus.

clue.text: Mostly a dessert — also known as a main course

indicators.note: mostly means most of the word, so its final letter is dropped

parts.note: mousse is a light whipped dessert

explanation.surface: A menu item is mainly pudding, though it goes by another name too.
explanation.definitionFit: Moussaka is a Greek baked dish of aubergine and minced meat, served as an entree.

clue.text: First-class spinner added to score

parts.note: a top is a toy that spins
to score is to cut a notch or mark

explanation.surface: A top-class slow bowler joins the team to boost the total.
explanation.walkthrough: The cricket picture of a spin bowler adding runs misleads; the spinner is a toy.
explanation.definitionFit: Excellent, of the highest quality.

clue.text: Timber felled round north — pine

indicators.note: round means the timber surrounds the next piece

parts.note: a log is a length of felled timber
N is the compass abbreviation for north

explanation.surface: Lumberjacks fell trees in the north, including a pine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pine' looks like a tree in this forestry picture, but it is the verb to yearn.
explanation.definitionFit: To pine is to yearn or ache for something.

clue.text: Went and passed such an ambiguous compliment

parts.note: left means departed, went away
handed means passed over

explanation.surface: Someone departed after delivering a backhanded remark.
explanation.walkthrough: A left-handed compliment is an idiom for one that is secretly a criticism.
explanation.definitionFit: A left-handed compliment is an idiom for praise that hides an insult.

clue.text: Rhymes like hocus-pocus

parts.note: a rhyming reduplicated phrase for nonsense, just as hocus-pocus is itself one

explanation.definitionFit: Meaningless ritual or gibberish, a rhyming doubled phrase like hocus-pocus.

clue.text: Neat repackaging of toy range? Such patient support may be vital

definitions.text: Such patient support may be vital

parts.note: neat is an old word for cattle, here one ox

indicators.note: repackaging means wrapping the goods up again in a different form, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A tidy rewrapping of toys is described as essential for a hospital patient.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Neat' looks like the adjective tidy but is the archaic noun for cattle. 'repackaging of' turns TOY RANGE into YGENATOR.
explanation.definitionFit: An oxygenator is a medical device that adds oxygen to a patient's blood during surgery.

clue.text: Woman's name mentioned by prince

parts.note: Prince Hamlet says that weakness is called by the name of woman

explanation.definitionFit: Hamlet's line 'Frailty, thy name is woman' gives women this as a name.

clue.text: Displays to sailors the propeller

parts.note: to air things is to display them, so airs are displays
a ship's crew is its sailors

explanation.surface: Someone shows the ship's company the propeller.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Displays' is a verb in the surface but gives the plural noun AIRS.
explanation.definitionFit: An airscrew is an aircraft propeller.

clue.text: This feature's given rise to a surprising remark

definitions.text: This feature's given rise to a surprising remark

parts.words: This feature's given rise to a surprising remark
parts.note: a facial feature that is raised when someone hears something startling

explanation.definitionFit: A raised arch of hair above the eye signals surprise.

clue.text: In brisk fashion, railway announced having no problems

parts.note: BR stands for British Rail

indicators.note: announced means said out loud, so the word for without problems is used for its sound

parts.note: easily means without difficulty

explanation.surface: A railway announcement declares there are no problems.
explanation.walkthrough: British Rail was the UK national railway.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something in a breezy, lively and quick manner.

clue.text: Green that's never used

definitions.meaning: never yet tested or put to the test

explanation.definitionFit: Untried means inexperienced or not yet tested.

clue.text: After warning be securing loan for product of mine

parts.note: a horn is sounded as a warning

indicators.note: securing means holding something within, so BE wraps around the next piece

parts.note: to lend is to make a loan

explanation.surface: After a warning, someone takes out a loan to pay for something produced in a mine.
explanation.definitionFit: Hornblende is a dark mineral extracted from rock.

clue.text: Obliging, unlike the King's Head

definitions.meaning: Shakespeare's 'uneasy lies the head that wears a crown' makes the opposite apply to a king

explanation.definitionFit: Easy means compliant, and is the opposite of uneasy, Shakespeare's word for a crowned head.

clue.text: Decoration for dress second of fillies, say, trimmed

indicators.note: trimmed means the last letter is cut off

parts.note: equine means of horses, fillies being an example

explanation.surface: A dress decoration is the runner-up among young mares, perhaps cut short.
explanation.walkthrough: 'trimmed' drops the final E of EQUINE.
explanation.definitionFit: A sequin is a small shiny disc sewn on clothes as ornament.

clue.text: Ties in knots?

parts.note: neckties tied in knots, and items worn round the throat generally

explanation.definitionFit: Ties, scarves and cravats are items worn around the throat.

clue.text: Form of crude material, not dyed at first

indicators.note: a form of something is a version of it reshaped, so the letters are rearranged once the unwanted letter is set aside
at first points to the opening letter of the word

explanation.surface: A form of raw fabric that has not been dyed in the first place.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Form of' turns CRUDE into ECRUD; 'not' removes D, the first letter of 'dyed'.
explanation.definitionFit: Ecru is an unbleached, greyish-beige fabric or colour of raw linen.

clue.text: .Create a lot of interest in the plot

explanation.definitionFit: Intrigue means both to fascinate and a secret scheme.

clue.text: See some secret exercises directed towards West

indicators.note: in an across answer going west means running right to left, so the letters are read backwards
some means only part of the following words is used

explanation.surface: Some covert drills are pointed westwards.
explanation.walkthrough: 'some' finds RETEXE in 'secret exercises'; 'directed towards West' turns it back. A see is a bishop's diocese.
explanation.definitionFit: A see is a bishop's seat, and Exeter is a cathedral city in Devon.

clue.text: Basic senseless deception

parts.note: under means unconscious, as under anaesthetic
lying is deceiving

explanation.definitionFit: Underlying means fundamental, at the root of things.
